_comment: Per-theme defaults for tools/social/social.py: the caption under the screen (name, line) and warmup, seconds of the theme's own simulation before its first shown frame (time the app would already have run). Optional seed: f.seed for Metal themes (default 0x5EED, the harness's). Optional focus: the zoom format's target, as a fraction of the frame (Cygnus_A: the shadow's centre, measured on a 1512x982 render). A theme not listed here gets its file name as the caption, no second line and 8 s of warm-up.
